theorem odd_triangle {K : Type} [CommRing K] (a b c : K) : ((a + b) - (b + c)) + (c + a) = 2 * a
theorem two_odd_triangles {K : Type} [CommRing K] (a b c d e : K) : (((a + b) - (b + c)) + (c + a)) - (((a + d) - (d + e)) + (e + a)) = 0
theorem half_ground_edge {K : Type} [CommRing K] (a b : K) : 2 * (a + b) - 2 * a = 2 * b
theorem dot_zero {C K : Type} [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (r : C → K) : dot columns r (fun _ => 0) = 0
theorem dot_add {C K : Type} [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (r v w : C → K) : dot columns r (fun c => v c + w c) = dot columns r v + dot columns r w
theorem dot_scale {C K : Type} [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (r v : C → K) (s : K) : dot columns r (fun c => s * v c) = s * dot columns r v
